title: COMP Instance 3 Page
summary: Official Derivative common Instance 3 page reference for assigning arbitrary custom attributes to instances for GLSL MAT access through TDInstanceCustomAttrib functions.
guidance: Use this article when a Geometry COMP instancing plan needs custom per-instance attributes consumed by a GLSL MAT.
Access the custom attributes in GLSL with TDInstanceCustomAttrib0(), TDInstanceCustomAttrib1(), and related generated functions.
These custom attributes are ignored in other materials such as PBR MAT, so use GLSL MAT when custom instance attributes must drive shading.
Different GPUs support different maximum numbers of custom instance attributes, so avoid assuming an unlimited number of custom slots.
